literal: family capability within that-came fault a-man laziness nature to-remove will-perish
translation: When a man casts off the trait of laziness, any faults that have compromised his capability to uphold his family will perish.
modern: ஒருவன் தன்னிடம் உள்ள சோம்பல் என்னும் தன்மையை ஒழித்தால், அவனது குடியைக் காக்கும் திறமையில் ஏற்பட்ட குற்றங்கள் அழிந்துவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how laziness directly harms a person's ability to support and elevate their family. The word 'kuṭiyāṇmai' refers to the capability or duty required to maintain one's household, while 'maṭiyāṇmai' refers to the state of being ruled by laziness. The poet states that any faults or decline that have crept into a family's standing are not permanent. If a person simply removes their laziness, those faults will automatically perish, restoring the family's strength.
